title: Membership Freeze Save Console
oneLiner: A gym retention console that identifies members about to freeze or cancel and recommends the fastest save action.
targetUser: Boutique gym owners, retention managers, and coach-led member success teams.
keyUX: Find members most likely to freeze, understand why the signal changed, and trigger the best save action in minutes.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop gym retention operations dashboard called Membership Freeze Save Console for boutique gym owners and member success managers. It should help teams rescue at-risk members before they freeze or cancel by combining attendance drop, unused sessions, billing friction, coach notes, and likely save actions in one focused workflow. Include a retention KPI hero, an at-risk member queue, an attendance-payment-package signal table, an action recommendation panel, a coach notes drawer, and a recovered revenue rail. Design direction: use a dense operator-console style with charcoal, warm white, muted lime, and disciplined electric blue accents; keep the interface fast to scan, operationally sharp, and clearly optimized for daily intervention work.
